items.summary: Maintain containment-only execution; do not queue or requeue work this cycle. Retain these CEO/CTO handoffs for reconsideration after failure-repair, measurement, attribution, release, and security gates clear. 1) saveusfarms.com CTR recovery: evidence is 1,668 impressions, position 10.5, 0 clicks for the Michigan land-preservation query. Fleet use case: rewrite the title/meta description and strengthen one relevant internal-link path. Expected metric: non-brand query CTR toward the 1.2% conservative target; time-to-learn: existing search measurement window or 100 new impressions; smallest reversible prototype: metadata-only change on the named article, with prior metadata as rollback. 2) allthingsmasonic.com affiliate-intent merchandising: evidence is 61 affiliate clicks, 3 conversions, and no attributed commission in the recorded provider period; revenue remains unattributed. Fleet use case: add one intent-led comparison/selection block using existing catalog links and registered tracking ID. Expected metric: affiliate click-through rate and attributable ordered items, without claiming revenue lift; time-to-learn: 14 days or 100 new impressions; smallest prototype: one static block on the highest-intent existing page, removable by reverting the component. 3) reusable CTA/accessibility pattern: bounded evidence from the 0xroulette.com entry-surface inspection and existing UX work supports a portable hierarchy pattern, but no causal lift is established. Fleet use case: improve primary-action clarity and keyboard-visible focus without new tracking or dependencies. Expected metric: existing CTA clicks or page-level conversions where already recorded; time-to-learn: 14 days after an eligible deployment; smallest prototype: one site, one primary CTA, one reversible variant. Risk: preserve disclosures, destinations, consent, and accessibility behavior. 4) control-plane measurement/deduplication capability: evidence shows 192 approved proposals without execution, 52 failed-request follow-ups, 33 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, and only 2 proven outcomes; this is an operating-product opportunity, not proof of financial lift. Fleet use case: expose request/improvement state, deduplicate active work, and bind every eligible change to baseline, metric, measurement window, and rollback. Expected metric: lower duplicate/stranded work and higher verified execution rate; time-to-learn: one existing cycle; smallest prototype: read-only state reconciliation for one lane using existing records only. Risks across all items: no new telemetry, dependencies, spend, credentials, domains, deployment, or unsupported revenue/ROI claims. Decision handoff: CEO/CTO retain as deferred backlog and reconsider only when queue eligibility and gates clear.
